name: DBS Group Holdings Ltd
summary: DBS Group Holdings Ltd provides commercial banking and financial services in Singapore, Hong Kong, rest of Greater China, South and Southeast Asia, and internationally. It operates through Personal Banking; Institutional Banking; and Global Financial Markets segments. The Personal Banking segment offers banking and related financial services, including current and savings accounts, fixed deposits, loans and home finance, cards, payments, investment, and insurance products for individual customers.
